title: Gilgamesh
summary: In tradition Gilgamesh was a king of Uruk in southern Mesopotamia and the hero of the Epic of Gilgamesh. The Sumerian King List gives him a reign of 126 years; some scholars treat him as based on a real early ruler, but the epic was written centuries later and its deeds cannot be verified.

uncertainty.note: Traditional reign placed in the 26th century BCE; the Sumerian King List gives 126 years, which is legendary, so the dates here are approximate and traditional.

as_recorded.value: reigned in the 26th century BCE; reign of 126 years in the Sumerian King List

where.historical_name: Uruk, city of Sumer in southern Mesopotamia

importance.justification: Central figure of one of the oldest surviving works of literature.

sources.title: Ancient Clay Tablet Offers New Insights into the Gilgamesh Epic

reviewer_note: Least sure of the 26th-century date, which comes from one reference source plus the legendary king list. The BAS page was used for the epic traditions (king of Uruk, 11-tablet standard version), not for dating.
